query: UPDATE discovery_entries e SET state=CASE WHEN e.state='withdrawn' OR $2 THEN 'withdrawn' ELSE 'denied' END,revision=revision+1,title=NULL,summary=NULL,language=NULL,published_at=NULL,sensitive=false,invalidation_reason=$3,updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM discovery_video_details v WHERE e.id=v.entry_id AND (v.owner_uri=$1 OR v.channel_uri=$1)
